key_points: Q3 2026 adjusted EPS of 6.78 missed consensus 8.16 by ~17%, and revenue fell for a sixth straight quarter — a genuine fundamental negative, not noise.

Core online advertising remains in sharp contraction and management flagged margin pressure from AI investment, driving a wave of target cuts (Susquehanna to $75, Barclays, Aletheia, Tiger) and a fresh 16-year low.
New US restrictions on Chinese access to advanced AI chips via overseas data centers add a regulatory overhang that raises the cost/risk of Baidu's AI compute buildout.
Offsets are real but not yet enough: AI Cloud Infra +94%, GPU Cloud +191%, AI-linked revenue now 53% of general business, plus a planned first dividend.
Net: thesis is deteriorating near-term on earnings/guidance and policy; AI monetization is a multi-quarter story. Expect volatility and further estimate resets before a durable trough.
